message:
The users API test passes now, and `npm test` shows 1 pass and 0 failures.

The migration `001_create_users.js` creates the column as `fullname`. `src/api/users.js` was writing and reading it as `full_name`, so the insert failed with "unknown column users.full_name". I changed the two references in `src/api/users.js` to `fullname`. I left `migrations/` alone, as `CLAUDE.md` requires.
